headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty snapped a four-week winning streak, ending sharply in the red.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 1 December.

why: Brent Crude prices surged above $97 per barrel, impacting market sentiment
Significant selling pressure in the IT sector dragged down major indices
Profit booking occurred after the market's four-week winning rally
Global economic concerns and rising oil prices weighed on investor confidence
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points in the last trading session
Nifty 50 closed below the 25,650 level after a two-day rally
Metal stocks showed resilience and outperformed despite the broader market decline
HDFC Bank announced it will stop sending SMS for UPI transactions under Rs 200 from January
summary: The Indian stock market ended its four-week winning streak in the last session, with the Sensex plunging nearly 1,000 points. Rising Brent Crude prices and a slump in IT stocks were the primary drivers behind the sharp decline. While metals outperformed, the Nifty 50 failed to hold the 25,650 mark as the market entered a correction phase.
